problems.title: "Join Lumi" opens a "1 of 6" goals quiz instead of an e-mail field
problems.summary: All four first-open personas remarked on the 6-step setup; Jordan quit on its first screen. Aisha and Minji pushed through but used most of their patience; the communities step confused two of them (dorm chip has no dorm picker; "Membership is verified separately").
problems.rootCauseHypothesis: Profiling before the account; "1 of 6" makes the length explicit right after the student chose to join.

evidence.quote: 1 of 6?? i tapped join, not take a survey. six screens before i even see a person. nope
Still no e-mail — this is a long sign-up. 'Membership is verified separately'… I don't be
뭐지? 그냥 '기숙사' 체크만 됨. 내 기숙사는 어디서 고르는 거야?

problems.suggestedFix: Account (school e-mail) first, then at most one goals screen; make the rest optional after entering the app.

problems.title: Guest club sheet repeats the one-line description and offers only "Follow"
problems.summary: All four personas opened a club in the new guest preview and found only the list description again plus Follow — no meeting time, open/apply status, members or events. Aisha worried Follow would look like rushing a fraternity.
problems.rootCauseHypothesis: Guest club sheet shows only list fields; imported clubs carry little more.

evidence.quote: that's it? same sentence again. no people, no next hackathon date, nothing.
It doesn't tell me if I have to apply or if it's open
설명 한 줄이랑 팔로우 버튼만... 사람이 있는지 모르겠어요.

problems.suggestedFix: Show meeting time, "open to all / application", official link and a member count; say Follow is private.

problems.title: Club list "Recommended" is A–Z, opening on sororities and fraternities
problems.summary: Three personas noticed in the guest preview today (six personas this week).
problems.rootCauseHypothesis: "Recommended" has no signal for guests and falls back to alphabetical.

evidence.quote: lol 'recommended' is just A to Z. four sororities in a row.

problems.suggestedFix: For guests, sort by popularity or category variety; label the sort honestly ("A–Z").

problems.environmentNote: Live events snapshot (real). Home gym/dining tiles were empty only because of the local stack.
problems.title: Guest Explore and first "For you" items are faculty talks and career fairs, not student life
problems.summary: First guest event was an emeriti speaker series for three personas; after sign-up Aisha and Minji (picked meet people/clubs) got career fairs and law events first.
problems.rootCauseHypothesis: Ranking ignores role and picked goals; live events are faculty/career-heavy.

evidence.quote: 첫번째가 은퇴 교수 강연ㅋㅋ 나랑 상관없음.
the first 'For you' thing is career fairs — I picked clubs and meeting people
'새 사람 만나기' 골랐는데 또 행사 리스트네.

problems.suggestedFix: Hide faculty/emeriti series from undergrad defaults; boost goals picked in onboarding.

problems.title: Search misses: "public health"/"first-gen" find no clubs, "SFO" returns yoga and a talk
problems.summary: Aisha found no clubs for her major or first-gen; Seoyeon's "SFO" event search returned unrelated items instead of "no results"; a filter silently kept the old query.
problems.rootCauseHypothesis: Fuzzy search with loose matching; no tag/major index; no "showing results for" hint.

evidence.quote: Nothing for public health? At Berkeley? That's literally my major.
SFO 검색했는데 요가? 왜 이게 나오지?

problems.suggestedFix: Exact-match first with an honest "no results"; index club categories/majors; show the active query on filters.

problems.title: Language toggle is a tiny "English" label (44×20) — easy to miss, but switching works
problems.summary: Both Korean personas found it and loved the instant switch, but nearly missed it.

evidence.quote: 오 바로 한국어 됐다! 좋아. 근데 tiny 'English' 글씨라 거의 못 볼 뻔

problems.suggestedFix: Larger pill with 🌐 and both language names.

problems.title: The Social preview in sign-up never says who can see your profile or message you
problems.summary: Aisha liked the small-plan preview but could not tell who sees her; privacy lines on the last step are what convinced her.
problems.rootCauseHypothesis: Privacy copy only appears on the final form.

evidence.quote: 'coffee after class' with people from my classes — that's small and not scary.

problems.suggestedFix: One line under the Social preview: "Only Berkeley students see you; only friends can message".
